## Research Interests

Fluid–structure interaction, collapsible-channel and collapsible-tube flows,
hydrodynamic stability, nonlinear dynamics and numerical methods for fluid mechanics.

## Research Experience

**Doctoral Researcher** — University of Sevilla, Department of Fluid Mechanics and Aerospace Engineering  
*2021–2026*  
Numerical investigation of steady solutions and hydrodynamic stability in collapsible-channel and collapsible-tube flows, using [JaM](https://miguelherrada.github.io/JAM/index.html) for coupled fluid–structure interaction problems.  
Funded by a [Spanish State Research Agency (AEI) predoctoral fellowship](https://www.aei.gob.es/convocatorias/buscador-convocatorias/ayudas-contratos-predoctorales-formacion-doctores-2020-2), awarded in 2021.

**Visiting Student** — University of Manchester, Department of Mathematics  
*Summer 2025*  
Numerical modelling of wrinkling and draping in elastic disks using [oomph-lib](https://oomph-lib.github.io/oomph-lib/doc/html/index.html).
